title: Attention calibration
description: The units the attention field is measured in, per docs/03-attention.md#scale-and-calibration. One entry, and everything that emits is expressed as a ratio against it.

id.description: Stable namespaced id. Permanent once shipped.

cellMetres.description: Metres per field cell. 4 m, deliberately coarser than the 1 m tile grid.

attenuationPerMetre.description: Magnitude lost per metre of open ground. 0.7, which makes reach = magnitude / 0.7 metres.

wallPenaltyMetres.description: Extra travel a solid cell costs, in metres. 18 m -- being indoors is worth real distance.

noiseHalfLifeSeconds.description: Noise half-life. ~3 s, so a shout is inaudible about fifteen seconds later and the horde it summoned is still walking.

floor.description: Below this a cell is silent and propagation stops. Near zero, because docs/03 states reach as magnitude / attenuation. Not a hearing threshold -- a sensory profile applies that per zombie.

scentHalfLifeMinutes.description: Scent half-life. Minutes, not seconds -- docs/03 calls scent decay slow (hours) against noise's ~3 s, and a different unit is the point: it is what stops the two channels being reasoned about as one.

scentDiffusionRate.description: Fraction of a cell's scent that leaves it per diffusion step, shared out among the four neighbours by the wind weights.

scentIntervalTicks.description: Ticks between diffusion steps. 5 at 20 Hz is 4 Hz -- docs/03's "a diffusion step at a few Hz". Scent is continuous, so this is the knob that sets what continuous costs.

scentCeiling.description: Maximum scent in one cell. Scent accumulates rather than taking a maximum the way noise does, so a permanent emitter needs a ceiling or a long run walks a Float32 somewhere canonicalize cannot follow.

windX.description: Global wind vector, x. Length is strength: 0,0 is dead calm and diffusion is isotropic. Constant for now -- docs/16-weather.md owns wind from Milestone 3, and this is the seam it takes over.

windY.description: Global wind vector, y. See windX.

scentFloor.description: Below this a cell has no scent left. Separate from `floor`, which is a noise constant: that one is near zero so that reach = magnitude / attenuation holds exactly, an identity a diffusive channel does not have. Sharing it made the floor rather than the half-life govern how long a smell lasted.
